_comment: Settings for the GulfCoastMesh Mobile option, sent to the device's CLI after a flash. Run in order; a leading underscore parks a note or a command without deleting it.
_units: advert.interval: minutes (60-240). flood.advert.interval: hours (3-168). agc.reset.interval: seconds, rounded down to a multiple of 4. Both intervals take 0 to disable.
_radio: Sets freq/bw/sf/cr together, COMMA-separated -- spaces parse as one field and the command is rejected. Out-of-range is rejected, not clamped. Needs a reboot, which the flasher sends itself after the list.
_regions: def walks a cursor from the wildcard *: a bare token creates a child and moves onto it, 'name|jump' creates a child then jumps elsewhere. Cursor resets to * per command. 160 chars max per line.
_regions_notes: def merges into the existing tree rather than replacing it; 'region remove' first for a clean slate. 'region save' persists it. 'region allowf *' is what carries unscoped floods -- they match no named region, so the wildcard's flag decides, and a preserved region file could have it denied.
commands: region def us us-al|us us-fl|us us-ms|us us-la|*
